description: Pinned official public assets for ARM64 Pip speech qualification. Private models (hey_pip.onnx) and private human recordings are NEVER listed here or copied into the repo.

whisper_tiny_en.name: ggml-tiny.en.bin
whisper_tiny_en.license: MIT (OpenAI Whisper weights: https://github.com/openai/whisper/blob/main/LICENSE; GGML conversion by ggerganov/whisper.cpp)

openwakeword_melspectrogram.name: melspectrogram.onnx
openwakeword_melspectrogram.upstream_notice: dscripka/openWakeWord v0.5.1 release binary (ONNX export of torchaudio MelSpectrogram). Repository code is Apache-2.0, but release ONNX weights do not include a separate model-specific license file; operator review required prior to distribution.

openwakeword_embedding.name: embedding_model.onnx
openwakeword_embedding.upstream_notice: dscripka/openWakeWord v0.5.1 release binary. Per upstream README, derived from Google TFHub google/speech_embedding/1 (listed as Apache-2.0 on TFHub), re-implemented and exported by openWakeWord without a separate weight-specific license file; operator review required prior to distribution.
